Figure 1 establishes the scale of the dataset and the dominant bacterial
phyla across compartments. Three panels:

* **A.** geographic map of the 60 sampling sites, colored by habitat type
* **B.** sequencing-yield summary by trip and compartment
* **C.** phylum-level composition across the three compartments

```{python}
#| label: setup
import sys
from pathlib import Path
REPO = Path.cwd().parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(REPO / "src"))

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

from eq import CACHE_DIR, FIGURES_DIR
from eq.diversity import aggregate_to_rank, relative_abundance, top_n_groups
from eq.loader import load_site_geodata

plt.rcParams.update({
    "figure.dpi": 120,
    "font.family": "DejaVu Sans",
    "font.size": 9,
    "axes.spines.top": False,
    "axes.spines.right": False,
})
```

## Load cached tables

```{python}
#| label: load
ft = pd.read_parquet(CACHE_DIR / "feature_table.parquet")
tax = pd.read_parquet(CACHE_DIR / "taxonomy.parquet")
meta = pd.read_parquet(CACHE_DIR / "metadata.parquet")
# Only real samples
meta = meta.dropna(subset=["trip", "compartment"]).copy()
meta["trip"] = meta["trip"].astype(int)
meta["site"] = meta["site"].astype(int)
ft = ft[meta.index]
print(f"Analysis-ready: {ft.shape[0]:,} ASVs × {ft.shape[1]:,} samples")
print(f"  sum reads: {int(ft.values.sum()):,}")
print(f"  median reads/sample: {ft.sum(axis=0).median():,.0f}")
```

## Site geodata + habitat classification

```{python}
#| label: geodata
geo = load_site_geodata().reset_index()
# Trip 5 has the richest metadata — use it for habitat labels if the
# same site had only geocoords in earlier trips.
habitat = (
    pd.concat([pd.read_csv(REPO / f"data/geodata/trip{t}_geodata.tsv", sep="\t")
               for t in (1, 3, 5)])
)
# We dont have an explicit 'habitat' column yet; pull from the samplesheet
# notes.  Fall back to a single label while we plumb the sheet in.
habitat_map = pd.read_csv(
    REPO / "../code-and-data/data/metadata/samplesheets/trip5-2025.tsv",
    sep="\t", usecols=["site", "feature"],
).dropna()
habitat_map["site"] = pd.to_numeric(habitat_map["site"], errors="coerce").astype("Int64")
habitat_map = habitat_map.dropna().astype({"site": int}).drop_duplicates("site")

site_coord = (
    geo.drop_duplicates("site")[["site", "Latitude", "Longitude"]]
       .dropna().astype({"site": int}).set_index("site")
)
site_coord = site_coord.join(habitat_map.set_index("site")["feature"]).fillna("unknown")
site_coord.head()
```

## Panel A — site map

```{python}
#| label: fig1-map
#| fig-cap: "60 sampling sites across the Rub' al-Khali, coloured by habitat type"
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 4))
palette = sns.color_palette("Set2", n_colors=site_coord["feature"].nunique())
cmap = dict(zip(sorted(site_coord["feature"].unique()), palette))
for feat, grp in site_coord.groupby("feature"):
    ax.scatter(grp["Longitude"], grp["Latitude"], s=70, color=cmap[feat],
               edgecolor="k", linewidth=0.5, label=feat)
ax.set_xlabel("longitude (°E)")
ax.set_ylabel("latitude (°N)")
ax.set_title(f"{len(site_coord)} sampling sites · Rub' al-Khali")
ax.legend(fontsize=7, loc="lower right", ncol=2, frameon=True)
ax.set_aspect("equal")
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig(FIGURES_DIR / "fig1a_sites.pdf", bbox_inches="tight")
plt.show()
```

## Panel B — sequencing yield

```{python}
#| label: fig1-yield
yield_tbl = (
    meta.assign(n=1, reads=ft.sum(axis=0).values)
        .pivot_table(index="trip", columns="compartment",
                     values="n", aggfunc="sum", fill_value=0)
        .assign(total=lambda d: d.sum(axis=1))
)
read_tbl = (
    meta.assign(reads=ft.sum(axis=0).values)
        .groupby("trip")["reads"].agg(["sum", "median"])
        .rename(columns={"sum": "reads_total", "median": "reads_median"})
)
print(yield_tbl.join(read_tbl).to_string())
```

## Panel C — phylum composition

```{python}
#| label: fig1-phyla
phy = aggregate_to_rank(ft, tax, rank="phylum")
phy_rel = relative_abundance(phy)
top = top_n_groups(phy_rel, n=10)
# Collapse to (phylum x compartment) mean relative abundance
panel = (
    top.T.join(meta[["compartment"]])
        .groupby("compartment").mean().T
)
# Order phyla by overall mean
order = panel.mean(axis=1).sort_values(ascending=False).index
panel = panel.loc[order]

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6, 4))
panel.T.plot.bar(stacked=True, ax=ax, colormap="tab20",
                 edgecolor="white", linewidth=0.3)
ax.set_ylabel("mean relative abundance")
ax.set_xlabel("")
ax.set_title("Dominant phyla across compartments")
ax.legend(title="phylum", bbox_to_anchor=(1.02, 1), loc="upper left",
          fontsize=7, frameon=False)
plt.xticks(rotation=0)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig(FIGURES_DIR / "fig1c_phyla.pdf", bbox_inches="tight")
plt.show()
```

## Summary statistics for the abstract

```{python}
#| label: abstract-stats
stats = {
    "n_samples": ft.shape[1],
    "n_asvs": ft.shape[0],
    "total_reads_million": int(ft.values.sum() / 1e6),
    "n_trips": int(meta["trip"].nunique()),
    "n_sites": int(meta["site"].nunique()),
    "lat_range": f"{site_coord['Latitude'].min():.2f}–{site_coord['Latitude'].max():.2f}°N",
    "lon_range": f"{site_coord['Longitude'].min():.2f}–{site_coord['Longitude'].max():.2f}°E",
}
for k, v in stats.items():
    print(f"  {k}: {v}")
```
